BiblicalUsage: Nakon is the owner of the threshingfloor where Uzzah reached out to steady the ark, and his name marks the place of that judgment. In 2 Samuel 6:6 when they come to Nachon's threshingfloor, Uzzah puts forth his hand to the ark of God and takes hold of it, because the oxen shook it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the threshingfloor of Nachon is a warning about holy things handled carelessly. Uzzah meant well, and the ark still struck him down, because God's holiness is not steadied by a human hand.
